lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Alright now, hear me out: So I fire the Special Beam Cannon with one hand, right?'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'NO! NOT LIKE THE KAMEHAMEHA! THE KAMEHAMEHA DOESN'T *DRILL* THINGS!'

lines.text: 'Last time I checked, neither do cannons.'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Hey, Mr. Piccolo! Look what I found - it's a dragon!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'It's just Gohan. If you ignore it, it'll go away.'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I taught him how to dance. Show him Icarus!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'So do you just ignore all of your problems?'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'No. Some of them I invite to live in my *head*.'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Well, I'm sorry, it's just that there's so much space in here I didn't think you'd-'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: '-Ahhhh! Oh my God, what the hell is that?!'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Ahh! I don't know! It's like someone's torturing a frickin' cat!'

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Mr. Popo, are you torturing a cat?!

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Oh come on Kami, I don't torture cats.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: GOHAN I WILL CARVE YOU LIKE A PUMPKIN!!
"I Don't Want To Miss A Thing" plays in the background

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Honey! Good news: I've isolated the gay gene!

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Now we'll finally be able to make it through Manhattan at a decent time. I knew this combination telescope microscope would come in handy.

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Also, there's a giant meteor coming towards the planet. QUICK! Get me Bruce Willis, Steve Buscemi, and Aerosmith.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: So if I blow this meteor up, I get bacon?

lines.text: Well, good news is we're not dead.

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: And hey, the city's OK too. Hell, there's even a new building.

lines.text: What the heck do you think's inside?

lines.text: I BET IT'S JESUS! I'm calling Jesus! You heard it here, folks! I said Jesus!

lines.speaker: Mook
lines.text: OK guys, move out. This is easy pickings.

lines.text: Something about what I just said doesn't sound right.

lines.text: You can just say "terra-freezing process"; "terra-freezing the planet" sounds REDUNDANT.

lines.text: WELL, WHY IS IT TAKING SO LONG?!

lines.speaker: Gyoshu

lines.speaker: Zeeun
lines.text: -uh OH! Wuh I I-I uh, I am so sorry, that was a total slip-up on my part!

lines.speaker: Zeeun
lines.text: Please forgive me King Piccolo...I did it again (!)

lines.text: Well, King Piccolo, I believe it will take...

lines.speaker: Gyoshu
lines.text: NO WAIT! I SAID IT BECAUSE HE DID IT! I SAID IT BECAUSE HE DID--IIIIT!!!

lines.text: Well, Lord Slug, it is my humble opinion, Lord Slug, that it will take three days, Lord Slug...Go Team Slug.

lines.text: You see, just because I'm a woman...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'Oh well... it's a good thing none of these guys don't know what a Dragon Ball is.'

lines.text: LET ME GO, YOU CRAZY BITCH!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: LEAVE NOW! OR I WILL USE MY VOODOO POWERS ON YOU!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: You're talking to the pig, right?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh, I am at least an eight!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: Hehh hmm heh hmm hmm mrrghough duh.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: What? You know what the Dragon Balls are?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: And you wanna collect all seven?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well tough luck, Jolly Green Jackass, because I'm the only one with a radar to find them.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh God! Get off me! Where's my rape mace?! NO NO NOOO!!!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: Huegh heh hiergh hmm ngh hagh huh hiergh.

lines.text: Hmm hergh hrmm hugh heh hgerlh.

lines.text: YOU WANT US TO FIND THEM ALL IN AN HOUR?!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: HRRGH HURGH HUH HEH HAH HUH HRRROUGH!!!

lines.text: I am the Eternal Dragon. Why have you summoned me?

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: HRUGH HMM HROUGH HAH HEH HIIIEEEGH!!!

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: You wish to return to the prime of your youth.

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: -...wait a second, hold on. Something seems really familiar about this...

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: LORD SLUG THE ALMIGHTY HAS RETURNED!!!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: My youth...my strength... MY IMPECCABLE SINGING VOICE!
♫ A parody of "What a Wonderful World" ♫

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: ♫ I see trees of brown! And skies of black! ♫

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: ♫ And I think to myself...what a wonderful world! ♫

lines.text: Turns out, it was full of bad guys too. Who knew?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wow! I must've been out for a while.

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: I know, right? It's almost like--

lines.text: It's really a shame how hard it is to find food with all the animals dying.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Yes, we just have to make do with what we have.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Gohan! Dragon soup's ready! It's finger licarus good!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: AND SO IS THE OUTFIT PICCOLO GAVE HIM!!!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: You can't touch me up here!

lines.speaker: Slug Mook
lines.text: ALRIGHTY! SH*T STOMP ON THE LITTLE KID!

lines.speaker: Slug Mook
lines.text: OH MY GOD ARE YOU BATMAN?! NOOO!!!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Yeah, like the last guys; they were all misfit minions and crap. What are you?

lines.text: We're just here for your planet. Though if I had to choose, I'd say I'm the pretty one.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: That makes you the weird one with the freaky power.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: And that would make you no doubt the big tough stupid one.

lines.speaker: Wings
lines.text: YOU TAKE THAT BACK OR I'LL KILL YOU!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: All right, all right, you're not tough.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Now now, that truck is not your eating disorder.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: So long since you've seen yours that you don't even recognize one, do ya?

lines.speaker: Medamatcha
lines.text: GO, MY LITTLE FREAKS OF NATURE!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh God, oh no, God! NO NO *NO* *NO*...!

lines.speaker: Wings
lines.text: He thinks he's so great. Imma show him.

lines.speaker: Wings
lines.text: All right, go for the left, he won't see me coming from-

lines.speaker: Wings
lines.text: Fine, I'll wait down here and catch him off guard.

lines.speaker: Wings
lines.text: Oh hey, I'm just waiting for that green jerk so I can surprise him.

lines.speaker: Wings
lines.text: Yeah, he'll never see it co-!

lines.speaker: Wings
lines.text: All right, look. I know we said some things... but I bet if we just talk to each other a little, we could become friends.

lines.text: All right babies, come back to Papa! It's Daddy's turn to get a shot at him now!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: WHY CAN'T YOU SAVE YOUR OWN DAMN SEEEELLLF?!?!

lines.speaker: Medamatcha
lines.text: Ha ha! The boss is gonna love this!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: My skin is so F*CKING smooth!

lines.speaker: Medamatcha
lines.text: PAPA MEDAMATCHA GONNA MAKE YOU HIS BITCH!

lines.speaker: Medamatcha
lines.text: Look, another couple of putzes to knock around! This should be fu-...

lines.speaker: Medamatcha
lines.text: -WHAT, BITCH?! I'M TALKING TO YOU! I WILL SMACK YOU WITH MY DICK!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Don't worry Gohan, I'll save Christmas.

lines.speaker: Angila
lines.text: Not to be rude, but we've got better things to do.

lines.speaker: Medamatcha
lines.text: Yeah, we're gonna take your planet and--

lines.speaker: Medamatcha
lines.text: OH, I DON'T GIVE A SH*T WHAT CHRISTMAS IS NOW!!

lines.speaker: Medamatcha
lines.text: I JUST KNOW I'M GOING TO KILL IT!

lines.speaker: Medamatcha
lines.text: AND THEN MY LITTLE MATCHAS ARE GOING TO *RAPE IT*!!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And that's how I saved Christmas.

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: God, we go through soldiers here like copy paper.

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: IF YOU'RE WITH THE GOVERNMENT OR THE CHURCH, GET THE F*CK OFF MY PROPERTY!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: Which, considering I now own this rock, is effectively *everything*.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Don't worry, Goku. Just sit on back and let Krillin handle this one.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh-ho, my God. This is going to be amazing.

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: You know, there's a certain sport I excel at.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Gohan, you wanna do that thing, where you get really mad and start beating the guy up?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'All right, I just gotta pull myself together. At least he's not shooting laser eyes at me or something.'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Oh great, Iguana Street. Now I'm gonna get mugged. But jokes on them; I have no mon--'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh hey, I should take Chi-Chi here. She'll love this place.

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: I feel like a young strapping lad, beating his meat furiously for the first time!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey, King Kai. My nipples are rigid right now.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Anyway, I noticed you're having a hard time down there.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah, he's pretty really strong. I'm not sure what to do.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: But if I fail, Christmas is *doomed*!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: D'I mean yes! Goku, it's Christmas, and you're about to let Christmas die!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: But he's so strong. I don't think I can--

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Goku! You're the only one who can do this! You are the Champion of Christmas!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: SON OF A BITCH! MY WHITTLING HAND!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Holy crap! Where'd this come from?!

lines.speaker: Talking Movie Bubbles
lines.text: Sir, if I might interject, that sounds positively ridiculous.

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: What the hell got into you?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I WILL STOP YOU FROM DESTROYING CHRISTMAS!!!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: What are you talking about? It's JULY!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: MOVIE BUBBLES, I SWEAR TO GOD!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, I still have to defeat you. And you can't win with a broken arm.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: No no no! You're supposed to leave it on, it gets better!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Or you know, grow it back... wait a minute, that means your...
Lord Slug yells during his power-up

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Hold on a minute. I know now! I know what he is! He's a--'

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: A Super Namekian, mind you, who's here to rule over your planet.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Apparently he is the banished other half of the Grand Elder Namekian, who became too old and decrepit to fight.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: But now he has used the Dragon Balls to return himself to his prime.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hold on a second. Now, I may not be the brightest knife in the crayon box... but that sure sounds a lot like...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You wouldn't be related to King Piccolo, would you?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hope that doesn't sound racist, I gotta be careful about that. We're still in Iguana Street...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'OK, do Namekians know about sensing energy? Seem to remember they don-...'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Eh, you know, kinda bummed it isn't actually Christmas.

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: Ahh, there's no kill quite like overki-...

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: HOW DID I MISS HIM?! I SHOT HIM POINT BLANK!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Now I know what you're thinking.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And the answer may surprise you.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Why does everyone laugh when they do that? That's my ribs crushing my *lungs*!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Nice to meet ya. I've got your antennae. Whatcha gonna do now?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Aha! I knew you'd do that!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Now for part TWO of my master plan!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: The hell is wrong with everyone on this planet?!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: GOHAN! I NEED YOU TO DO THAT THING THAT REALLY ANNOYS ME!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: YOU KNOW, THAT THING YOU WERE DOING EARLIER TODAY!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: IT REALLY GOT ON MY NERVES!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: HE HASN'T LOOSENED HIS GRIP YET SO YOU'RE PROBABLY NOT DOING IT!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: YOU WERE DOING IT WITH YOUR MOUTH!
Gohan whistles the opening theme to "The Andy Griffifth Show"

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: Oh my God. Oh my God. Oh my God! OH MY GOD! OH MY GOD! OH MY GOD!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: AHH, IT'S LIKE ONE DRILL IN ONE EAR! AND ANOTHER DRILL IN THE OTHER EAR! AND THEY'RE MEETING IN THE MIDDLLLEEEE!!!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Probably, should have, stretched, my arms...!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: THAT'S IT! Time for the universal mute button!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: Oh balls, that was my ship...

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: AND WHY ARE YOU STILL ALIVE?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Now I must go. My planet needs me.

lines.text: ♫ Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun, kill my enemies! ♫

lines.text: IF I'M GONNA DIE I'M TAKING YOU WITH ME!!!

lines.speaker: Lord Slug
lines.text: WHY DIDN'T I WISH FOR IMMORTALITYYYYY?!?!?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Now that I've defeated King Piccolo, I can wish back Chiaotzu, Master Roshi, and Krillin.

lines.text: ♫ How can you say that I don't give a... ♫

lines.text: ♫ By myself stupified coming back again. ♫

lines.text: NAAIIILL! COME AND MAAIIILL THIS FOR ME!
